producer_report.summary: Added an optional `[tools.sccache]` pin to the config. It holds only a `version`, defaults to absent, and rejects extra keys such as `sha256`. Setup now has a step that runs `cargo install --locked --version <v> --root <athena_home>/tools/sccache/<v> sccache`. It skips the install if the binary is already there and fails with a clear message if the install fails. It does nothing when no pin is set. Env values now expand `{athena_home}` through a new `expand` function in env.rs. `paths::sccache_root`, `sccache_binary_in` and `sccache_binary` derive the binary path from the one pinned version. I added decision D79 with the three alternatives and marked D46's sccache exclusion superseded. D79 says adoption in athena.toml comes in a later job. The CHANGELOG and README entries state that the real install was not run. athena.toml, defaults.toml and the other governance files are unchanged, and no digest was added. New tests cover config parsing with and without the pin, `{athena_home}` expansion, the path derivation, and the setup skip/failure/command paths. fmt, clippy and test all pass.

checks_run.note: all suites ok; includes the new tests

open_issues: The real `cargo install` of sccache was not run (it needs network and minutes). Only the injected-runner unit test covers the install path.
The athena.toml pin, RUSTC_WRAPPER and SCCACHE_DIR are left to the follow-up job, as the brief says.
The brief listed invocation.rs, setup.sh and athena.toml as deliverables. I left all three unchanged: the expansion lives in env.rs, setup.sh just runs xtask, and athena.toml stays untouched.
mistakes: First clippy run failed on a redundant closure in xtask; fixed.
The first CHANGELOG edit failed because the heading matched three places; I redid it with more context.
learnings: Env placeholder expansion is in crates/athena-agent/src/env.rs, not crates/athena-core/src/invocation.rs.
The newest decision before this change was D78, so the new one is D79.
docs/decisions.md says accepted entries are never rewritten. I added only a short pointer to D46's alternative (c).
Setup steps were renumbered because sccache is now step 4.
desires: Permission to read cargo's saved large-output files, so I could have checked the full test log.
